name: Rosewood Cape Kidnappers
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary sits on a working sheep and cattle farm overlooking dramatic limestone cliffs where the world's largest mainland gannet colony thrives just steps away.
whats_special: Rosewood Cape Kidnappers is one of only two places worldwide where you can witness massive gannet colonies on mainland cliffs rather than remote islands. The property spans 6,000 acres of pristine farmland with unobstructed Pacific Ocean views, while the nearby Cape Kidnappers Golf Course is consistently ranked among the world's top 50 courses, designed dramatically along the clifftops.
pro_tip: Visit during gannet season (July-February) for the best wildlife viewing, and book the farm-to-table experiences featuring lamb and beef raised right on the property.
dont_miss: The guided gannet safari to witness over 20,000 birds nesting on the clifftops, helicopter tours over the Hawke's Bay wine region, and sunset drinks at the Red Island restaurant while watching the farm's sheep being herded along the dramatic coastline.
pros: Dramatic clifftop location overlooking Hawke's Bay
World-class golf course designed by Tom Doak
Luxurious farm lodge experience with premium amenities
Exceptional spa treatments and wellness facilities
Access to exclusive wine country experiences
cons: Remote location requires significant travel planning
